summary: Retest of iter52 frontend PWA manifest swap bug. Verified both (a) /boutique page loads with <link rel=manifest> href pointing to backend /api/public/manifest.webmanifest?v=... (not static /manifest.json), and (b) uploading a logo via /console/parametres?tab=identite and clicking Enregistrer dispatches a branding-changed event (fired within 200ms, well under the 2s budget) and the manifest href is updated to a new ?v= cache-buster. Fix is working end-to-end. Backend check skipped per request (testing_type=frontend only).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in PeriodSelector.jsx line 96 (non-blocking but noisy in console)

critical_code_review_comments: BrandingBootstrapper.jsx still uses getElementById('dynamic-manifest') only; the described querySelector fallback is NOT present in the file. It works today because CRA happens to preserve the id on the <link rel=manifest> tag, but if HTML normalization ever strips it the swap will silently stop. Add the documented fallback: const manifest = document.getElementById('dynamic-manifest') || document.querySelector('link[rel="manifest"]'); and set manifest.id = 'dynamic-manifest' after lookup, as stated in the files_of_reference note.
PeriodSelector.jsx line 96: <option> contains a <span> wrapper (dev tooling injection) causing hydration warnings. Should render plain text inside <option>.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Manifest swap on /boutique and on branding-changed event both verified.
